title: On the Complexity of Finite-Sum Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization with Exact Proximal Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2611.04806v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Finite-sum nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax problems arise in adversarial training and distributionally robust learning. Known lower bounds for these problems cover only linear-span algorithms, zero-respecting algorithms, or a restricted proximal protocol. This leaves open whether unrestricted adaptivity or exact component proximal steps, which return global saddle points of regularized component problems, can improve the polynomial complexity. We show that they cannot. Consider $n\ge2$ components with joint mean-squared smoothness $L$ and condition number $\kappa\ge1$, and a starting point with primal gap at most $\Delta$ and joint gradient norm at most $\sqrt{2L\Delta}$. For $\varepsilon^2/(L\Delta)$ below a universal constant, every randomized adaptive algorithm with exact component values, gradients, and proximal responses requires at least $\Omega(n+\min\{\sqrt n\,\kappa,n^{3/4}\sqrt\kappa\}L\Delta/\varepsilon^2)$ expected com

translated_title: 关于具有精确近端预言机的有限和非凸-强凹极小极大优化的复杂度研究
translated_abstract: 有限和非凸-强凹极小极大问题广泛出现在对抗训练和分布式鲁棒学习中。针对这些问题已知的下界仅覆盖线性跨度算法、零尊重算法或受限的近端协议。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：无限制的自适应性或精确的分量近端步骤（即返回正则化分量问题的全局鞍点）能否改进多项式复杂度。本文证明它们不能。考虑具有联合均方光滑度 $L$ 和条件数 $\kappa\ge1$ 的 $n\ge2$ 个分量，以及原始间隙至多为 $\Delta$、联合梯度范数至多为 $\sqrt{2L\Delta}$ 的起始点。当 $\varepsilon^2/(L\Delta)$ 低于某个通用常数时，每个具有精确分量值、梯度和近端响应的随机自适应算法都需要至少 $\Omega(n+\min\{\sqrt n\,\kappa,n^{3/4}\sqrt\kappa\}L\Delta/\varepsilon^2)$ 的期望复杂度。
tldr: 本文证明了即使在允许无限制自适应性以及能返回正则化分量问题全局鞍点的精确分量近端预言机的最强设置下，有限和非凸-强凹极小极大优化的多项式复杂度下界也无法被改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that neither unrestricted adaptivity nor exact component proximal oracles—returning global saddle points of regularized component problems—can improve the polynomial complexity lower bounds for finite-sum nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization.
